text:
jen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a concrete plan for incident-driven testing. I sketched a small proposal: add a focused regression suite for the prompt that tripped the model fallback, a short load test that reproduces the burst pattern, and a chaos drill that simulates partial KV cache loss. Owners + timelines below, please chime in.

mike: SGTM. Can you paste the exact prompt set you want in the regression?

jen: pasted in the doc (link): https://redwood.internal/docs/postmortem/2024-11-fallback. Short version: 12 prompt templates that exercise long-context truncation + function-calling edges. We should version them as promptset:v1.

sara: I can own the promptset bakeoff and CI integration. ETA 2w to land tests in the regression runner.

luis: I can take the load test harness — need access to the Dedicated staging pool for realistic batching. @infra can you grant temporary creds?

arjun: I can coordinate the chaos drill (KV cache loss). Suggest we run it during the Friday game-day window. Also propose a rollback playbook snippet if the cache warms slowly.

mike: For the regression runner, can we add a metric that fails the job if median generation time increases >25% vs baseline? That would catch perf regressions early.

jen: yes — tie it to the existing eval infra, use the baseline from 2024-11-01. Add alert to eng-oncall if the regression fails after a PR merge.

luis: infra access request: I filed infra-ticket #4873. @incident-bot, any constraints on using Dedicated staging this week?

incident-bot: Deployment window available Fri 03:00-07:00 UTC; quotas limit sustained batch size to 512 tokens/sec in staging for non-prod jobs.

arjun: OK will plan the drill in that window. Question: do we want an automated fallback smoke test after a KV loss simulation to validate graceful degradation?

jen: yes — add a smoke route that hits the fallback policy and verifies latency < 600ms 95th. If it fails, trigger rollback/runbook.

sara: timeline recap: promptset v1 + CI hooks — 2w (sara). Load harness + staging creds — 1w after ticket (luis). Chaos drill runbook + game-day — 1w (arjun). Can we mark owners and dates in the postmortem doc?

mike: I'll add the metric + alert config as a PR to infra-evals repo, assign to @mike, target this Thursday for the PR.

jen: thanks. Can everyone add their one-line acceptance criteria here so we can close the postmortem follow-up? I’ll consolidate.

sara: Acceptance: prompt regression runs on every main branch merge and blocks if quality/latency regresses for the 12 incident prompts.

luis: Acceptance: load harness reproduces burst profile with 95th latency within 15% of production baseline in staging.

arjun: Acceptance: chaos drill simulates KV loss, verifies fallback correctness and rollback path, and logs metrics to console and SLO dashboard.

mike: Acceptance: alert fires on >25% median latency regression and creates a PagerDuty incident with runbook link.

jen: Great — I'll update the postmortem doc with owners, PR links, and due dates. If no objections I'll schedule a 15m sync on Friday to verify infra access and finalize game-day steps. :thumbsup:
